description: This file defines an interface `IGrainState<T>` representing the state of a grain, along with a default sealed implementation class `GrainState<T>` that provides serialization support for state management in Orleans grains. It includes properties for the state, an ETag for concurrency control, and a RecordExists flag, along with multiple constructors for initialization.

classes.name: GrainState<T>
classes.description: Default implementation of the `IGrainState<T>` interface, providing storage and serialization support for grain state, including constructors for initializing the state, ETag, and existence flag.
